mapper.select: INSERT INTO sales (sale_number, store_id, total_amount, status, sold_at, created_by) VALUES (#{saleNumber}, #{storeId}, #{totalAmount}, 'COMPLETED', #{soldAt}, #{createdBy}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sale_items (sale_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price) VALUES
(#{saleId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.totalPrice})
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.sale_number, s.sold_at, s.store_id, st.store_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id) AS item_count, s.total_amount, s.status, u.name AS created_by_name FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN users u ON u.id = s.created_by
ORDER BY s.sold_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.id, s.sale_number, s.store_id, st.store_name, s.sold_at, s.status, s.total_amount, cu.name AS created_by_name, s.cancelled_at, xu.name AS cancelled_by_name FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN users cu ON cu.id = s.created_by LEFT JOIN users xu ON xu.id = s.cancelled_by WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT si.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, si.quantity, si.unit_price, si.total_price FROM sale_items si JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id WHERE si.sale_id = #{saleId} ORDER BY si.id
mapper.update: UPDATE sales SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, cancelled_by = #{cancelledBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
